researchEvidence.note: Official OPLC Mechanical Safety and Licensing Board page reviewed; it describes the board's mission to ensure applicants are qualified for licensure.
Official OPLC application page reviewed; it lists Mechanical Business Entity application materials among mechanical safety licensing resources.
